intent: Implement TelemetryMeters (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Single owner of the Micrometer meter names and bounded tags of the context (tags are enumerations only, NEVER deviceId): counters telemetry.packets.received{source_kind}, telemetry.samples.validated{metric,status}, telemetry.samples.reordered{metric}, telemetry.revisions.appended{reason}; timer telemetry.pipeline.latency{stage in validate,history}. Consumers pin this unit and never spell meter names. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration (no stereotype annotation). Metrics are asserted through an injected SimpleMeterRegistry.

methods.semantics: Increments counter telemetry.packets.received with tag source_kind=sourceKind name.
Increments counter telemetry.samples.validated with tags metric and status.
Increments counter telemetry.samples.reordered with tag metric.
Increments counter telemetry.revisions.appended with tag reason.
Records timer telemetry.pipeline.latency with tag stage; stage must be one of validate, history (IllegalArgumentException otherwise).
